subject: Package is not available for Matlab 3.0.2

messages.author: 29b7e657009759e9
messages.subject: Package is not available for Matlab 3.0.2
parts:
Hi! 

I am new here and new to lavaan - I try to install it on a Ubuntu 14.04 LTS VM system with R 3.0.2 and R Studio.

I get always the error message that basically says that lavaan is not available for my R version:

> install.packages("lavaan", dependencies = TRUE)
Installing package into ‘/home/ferenc/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)
> install.packages("lavaan")
Installing package into ‘/home/ferenc/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)
> install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://cran.at.r-project.org/")
Installing package into ‘/home/ferenc/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)
> install.packages("lavaan", dependencies = TRUE, repos="http://cran.at.r-project.org/")
Installing package into ‘/home/ferenc/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.0’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

 I am a bit clueless here, where might be the problem?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Package is not available for Matlab 3.0.2
parts:
The subject line says "Matlab", but I'm sure you mean R.  It looks like you need a more recent version of R than the outdated 3.0.2 (the current version is 3.2.0).  If you can't find (or build) a recent version of R on Ubuntu, then you might be able to find an older version of lavaan on github that is compatible with R 3.0.2

Terry
